description: Summon-family G2 gate (first non-Snow family): spawn a line of hostiles, cast Void Spawn, and confirm three friendly Crawler_Void allies spawn and engage the hostiles (Summon spawned x3 + Summon attack resolved in the server log).
notes: Void Spawn summons three friendly Crawler_Void allies for 10s; test mobs line spawns three Test_Dummy_Stationary in front so the allies have hostiles to engage.
